name: tracker-codex
description: Tracks active Codex work in Tracker.

interface.shortDescription: Track active Codex work in Tracker.
interface.longDescription:
Records active Codex work as Tracker sessions, grouped by Git repository.

Setup:
1. From the plugin checkout, run: python3 tracker-codex/hooks/tracker_codex.py configure
2. Enter the Tracker URL, your personal token, and the device ID.
3. The values are stored only in ~/.config/tracker-codex/config.json and are accessible only to your user.

Check the setup at any time with: python3 tracker-codex/hooks/tracker_codex.py status
interface.defaultPrompt: Track this Codex session in Tracker.
